C1057.title: China Unicom Assists Police in Disrupting Illegal Access via Communication Devices
C1057.summary: On May 21, 2026, China Unicom's Linyi branch received an anti-fraud alert and discovered a man in an office building in Linyi Yimeng New District who had illegally connected two VOIP devices to Unicom's voice lines by splicing nine cables, building a fraud channel. Engineers cut power on site, and police detained the suspect and dismantled the equipment within 20 minutes.

references.title: China Unicom efficiently assists police in blocking illegal access to communication equipment
